Ruth (PM): Quick: need final GA acceptance checklist for Launch V1 by EOD Friday. Focus: SLA numbers, fallback routing behavior, burst billing cap, docs impact matrix. Any blockers?

Ken (Eng): SLA: can commit to 99.9% uptime per-route. Latency SLOs split into small/medium/large request buckets; large requests (>2k tokens) will have relaxed p99.

Asha (SRE): Monitoring/runbook: retain traces 7d for GA. Alert if fallback_rate > 5% for 10m -> page SRE and open incident. Add banner + FAQ link for customers.

Vik (FinOps): Billing: propose reserved base + capped burst multiplier. I'll post an example calc (token-level) tonight for docs.

Maya (Support): Support: GA help windows = business-hours for self-serve, 24/7 for enterprise. I will own the impact matrix mapping tiers -> expected fallback behavior and templates for customer comms.

Ken (Eng): Fallback plan: soft-fallback to quantized variant (q4f16) of same model; hard-fallback to smaller architecture only if necessary. Need feature-flag per-tenant + metric fallback_reason. Est 4 dev-days.

Ruth (PM): Docs must include impact matrix, short banner wording, FAQ entry explaining quality variance, and example invoice calc. Cannot sign off GA without those.

doc-bot: created -> ./docs/ga/launch-v1/impact-matrix.md (stub)

Vik (FinOps): Posting numeric examples tonight.

Ken (Eng): Opening flag + metrics PR (WIP).

Asha (SRE): I'll add alert rules to staging and the runbook steps.

Ruth (PM): Ok reconvene 09:00 PST tomorrow to lock wording. If no blockers, we'll call it locked. :white_check_mark:
